mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_password_reset_token (token_hash, user_id, operator_id, expiry_time, used, create_time, is_deleted, create_by) VALUES (#{tokenHash}, #{userId}, #{operatorId}, #{expiryTime}, COALESCE(#{used}, FALSE), COALESCE(#{createTime}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 0, #{createBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id, token_hash, user_id, operator_id, expiry_time, used, used_time, create_time FROM sys_password_reset_token WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_password_reset_token SET used = TRUE, used_time = #{usedTime}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE sys_password_reset_token SET used = TRUE, used_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND used = FALSE AND is_deleted = 0
